inputs.goal: investigate the S3 exfiltration alert; settle whether data left the account

leads.evidence: CloudTrail logs show 4.2TB of GetObject operations on prod-exports bucket during the alert window, which is 340% above the historical average of 1.2TB
The access key associated with the anomalous activity was last rotated on 2024-03-15, exceeding the 90-day rotation policy

Flow logs show egress traffic to IP addresses associated with ASN 12345, which is not in our approved list of external ASNs; however, the specific destination IPs cannot be definitively linked to data exfiltration
